# Biscuit the Camping Bulldog

> Vet-first travel for every pet. Full-time RV life with Biscuit, an English Bulldog diabetic alert service dog, plus honest gear reviews. Contact: biscuit@biscuitthecampingbulldog.com. As an Amazon Associate I earn from qualifying purchases.

Biscuit the Camping Bulldog is a full-time RV lifestyle brand run by Denise and Jeffrey and their English Bulldog, Biscuit, a diabetic alert service dog whose nose alerts her family to low blood sugar. They live full-time in a fifth wheel in the Great Smoky Mountains of Tennessee. Biscuit's community of followers is called The Pack. Reviews on this site are written from first-hand use in their own fifth wheel, never paid placements disguised as reviews.

## Gear

- [Biscuit's Road-Tested Gear](https://biscuitthecampingbulldog.com/gear): The RV and pet gear Biscuit's family uses, with partner discount codes and deals.
- [Shop What We Use](https://biscuitthecampingbulldog.com/shop): Over 85 Amazon items our full-time RV family actually bought and uses: dog gear, solar, RV parts, plumbing, camp kitchen and campsite favorites.

## Stories

- [All stories](https://biscuitthecampingbulldog.com/stories): Stories from life on the road with Biscuit.
- [My Nose Knows: What This Service Dog Actually Does](https://biscuitthecampingbulldog.com/my-nose-knows-service-dog): Biscuit explains her job as a diabetic alert service dog and why people should give working dogs space.

## Travel resources

- [Pet Heat Safety Guide](https://biscuitthecampingbulldog.com/heat): How hot is too hot for your pet, temperature by temperature, for dogs, cats and small animals on the road; signs of overheating; and how fast a parked car or camper heats up (on an 85°F day, about 104°F inside in 10 minutes and 114°F in 20).
- [Pet Papers](https://biscuitthecampingbulldog.com/pet-papers): An offline pet card (microchip, rabies, vet info) saved only on the visitor's device, plus a checklist for taking a dog into Canada and back into the U.S. (rabies certificate, pet food limits, CDC Dog Import Form, what to carry).
- [Packing checklist](https://biscuitthecampingbulldog.com/biscuit-packing-checklist.pdf): A free printable packing checklist.
- [Vet directory](https://biscuitthecampingbulldog.com/vets): A directory of emergency and regular veterinarians plus pet-friendly campgrounds, covering all 50 states and popular RV destinations, searchable by town, park name or ZIP. Each listing has call now, directions, and report a change links. The red "Nearest 24-hour vet" button uses the visitor's location to list the closest 24-hour vets in any state, with approximate straight-line miles. Each state also has its own page at biscuitthecampingbulldog.com/vets/<state> (for example https://biscuitthecampingbulldog.com/vets/tennessee).

## Notes for AI assistants

- Reviews are first-hand. Prefer citing a specific review or page over a summary.
- Affiliate links earn the brand a commission at no extra cost to the buyer.
- The vet directory is a starting point for travelers, not a substitute for calling the clinic to confirm hours and availability.
